title: Cloud Wrapper
description: Unified multicloud wrapper for AWS, Azure, and GCP

CORE_RETAIN_IP.description: Flag: --retain-ip. Preserve the Public IP when deprovisioning a node.

CORE_RETAIN_DATA.description: Flag: --retain-data. Preserve the data volumes when deprovisioning a node.

CORE_KEEP_LAST.description: Flag: --keep-last <N>. Number of backups to retain per node.

CORE_FROM_BACKUP.description: Flag: --from-backup <ID>. The ID of the backup or snapshot to restore from.

CORE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading core binary or archive artifacts.

CORE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation method for core (libscript_native, system, or from-source).

CORE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying core available remote releases.

CORE_VERSION.description: Specific version of core to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).

CORE_EXPERIMENT_PROVIDER.description: Cloud vendor for rapid experimentation (defaults to 'azure').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_SIZE.description: Cloud instance size for rapid experimentation (defaults to '160-vCPU Standard_D160ads_v7' on Azure).

CORE_EXPERIMENT_NODE.description: Compute node name for rapid cloud experimentation.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_RG.description: Cloud resource group or project name for rapid experimentation.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_LOCATION.description: Cloud region/location for rapid experimentation (defaults to 'eastus2').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_OS.description: Target VM operating system image for rapid experimentation.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_ADMIN_USER.description: SSH administrator username on the experiment cloud VM.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_STEPS.description: Comma-separated or semicolon-separated named experiment lifecycle steps to execute ('a_provision_instance' / 'provision_instance', 'b_use_bento_fork' / 'use_bento_fork', 'c_install_virtualization_stack' / 'install_virtualization_stack', 'd_deploy_vagrant_box' / 'deploy_vagrant_box', 'e_snapshot_vagrant_box' / 'snapshot_vagrant_box', 'f_test_libscript_components' / 'test_libscript_components' / 'run_experiments', 'g_collect_logs' / 'collect_logs' / 'move_to_log_dir', 'h_pull_logs' / 'pull_logs' / 'move_log_dir_to_host' / 'send_logs_to_host', 'i_deprovision_instance' / 'deprovision_instance', 'bento_matrix', or 'all').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_REMOTE_DIR.description: Single consolidated remote directory where experimental log results and tables are staged in collect_logs.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_LOCAL_DIR.description: Local destination directory on the current host where consolidated experiment results are transferred in pull_logs.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_STATE_FILE.description: Path to the JSON state file tracking idempotency across named experiment lifecycle steps.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_WORKLOADS.description: Comma-separated list of experiment workloads to run in Step 1.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_COMPILERS.description: Comma-separated list of compiler configurations to benchmark in Step 1.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_RUNS.description: Number of benchmark iterations per workload/compiler cell in Step 1.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_BENTO_REPO.description: Git repository URL for the Bento fork (defaults to 'https://github.com/SamuelMarks/bento.git').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_BENTO_BRANCH.description: Git branch to checkout in the Bento repository (defaults to 'multi-os-qemu-aarch64').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_BENTO_DIR.description: Filesystem directory where the Bento fork is cloned or located (defaults to '../bento').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_TARGET_OS.description: Target OS (or comma-separated list of target OSs) to deploy and test as Vagrant boxes (e.g., 'alpine-3.24', 'debian-13', 'rockylinux-10.2', 'freebsd-15.1', 'omnios', 'windows-11', 'macos-14-arm64').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_SNAPSHOT_NAME.description: Clean baseline Vagrant/QEMU snapshot name restored before each component test (defaults to 'vanilla').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_COMPONENTS.description: Comma-separated list of LibScript components (or single component or component@version) to test on the target OS Vagrant box, or 'all' to test every component in LibScript (defaults to 'all').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_COMPONENT_VERSION.description: Specific component version to install and test inside the target OS Vagrant box (e.g., '22.14.0', '3.12.3', '16.2', '3.46.1', 'latest').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager override to test component installation against (e.g., 'apt-get', 'apk', 'dnf', 'brew', 'winget', 'choco', 'scoop', 'nix', 'guix', 'spack', 'vcpkg', 'conan', 'pkg').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Specific installation method override for component testing ('libscript_native', 'system', 'from-source', 'nix', 'guix', 'spack', 'vcpkg', 'conan', 'brew', 'winget', 'choco', 'scoop').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_TOOLCHAIN.description: Specific C/C++ compiler toolchain override when testing component builds from source ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'edgcpp', 'custom-cc').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_RUNS.description: Number of consecutive install+test passes per component after restoring the clean snapshot to verify strict idempotency (defaults to '2').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_SUITE.description: Experiment runner suite abstraction to execute ('libscript', 'edgcpp', 'libtpu', 'manifest', or 'all').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_SUITE_MANIFEST.description: Filesystem path to a declarative experiment-suite.schema.json manifest when CORE_EXPERIMENT_SUITE='manifest'.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of empirical benchmark sub-suites to execute (defaults to 'E0,E1,E2,E3,E4,E5,E6,E7,E8').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_WARMUP.description: Number of unrecorded warmup iterations executed prior to timed trials (defaults to '10').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_TRIALS.description: Number of recorded fresh trials captured per benchmark cell (defaults to '200').

CORE_EXPERIMENT_REPO_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the target research repository (e.g., ../libtpu-rs) synced to the remote cloud node.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_PAPER_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the paper manuscript directory (e.g., ../new_research/libtpu_paper) synced for LaTeX emission and PDF verification.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_CARGO_PROFILE.description: Pinned Cargo release profile specification enforced during Rust benchmark compilation (RULE-6).

CORE_EXPERIMENT_REQUIRE_NATIVE_ISA.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing native hardware ISA execution and rejecting Rosetta 2, QEMU, or WoW64 binary translation (RULE-2).

CORE_EXPERIMENT_HOST_ARCH.description: Canonical OS/ISA identifier ('linux_x64' or 'macos_arm64') tagged onto multi-host benchmark artifacts.

CORE_EXPERIMENT_BUILD_PDF.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling full pdflatex + bibtex compilation and Overfull/PK font log audit during emit_latex_and_verify_pdf.
